description: Merged epam/ketcher pull requests that the review hub is measured on. `head` is the commit the maintainer reviewed, `base` the master commit it branched from. An entry with expected findings measures recall; an entry without them was approved with no comment, so every confirmed finding there is checked for a false positive.

entries.title: #12264 - Refactor: Explicit/implicit Any type clean up from packages\ketcher-react\src\typings.d.ts file
entries.head: 651cde97dfac704e15e534a0a1c2bbc7ece57b40

expected.summary: The custom global JSX namespace is likely unneeded: rely on the JSX types React ships instead of redeclaring them.
The subscription handler parameter is named `f`; use a full name such as `handler`.

entries.title: #12273 - Refactor: Explicit/implicit Any type clean up from packages\ketcher-react\src\script\editor\tool\rotate.ts file
entries.head: 076c2272728f4b0c005bbc011abd7d9c4d477c32

expected.summary: The test keeps a `@ts-ignore` above an assignment that already casts through `unknown`; the suppression is likely unneeded.
The new `RotateDragContext` type repeats a drag context that other tools define too; share a base type and extend it.

entries.title: #10221 - Support library searching using three letter amino-acid codes

expected.summary: The three-letter code match sits beside `checkMonomerMatch` in the filter instead of inside it, so the monomer matching logic is split over two places.
